title: Media bin
brief: The media bin for Global Service Studio (T5, ADR 0008), fitted into the chosen service-plan Live and Prepare layout. Live: images and videos as thumbnails with type, length, resolution, codec and a 'Heavy on this Mac' mark for formats without hardware decoding; one click or Return sends an image or looping video to the background; the item on the media layer is marked with text (ON AIR · Background), never color alone; Clear Slide F1, Clear Background F2 and Clear All F3 stay visible. A separate Play Full Screen action (⌘↩) shows a transport (play/pause, back and forward 10 s, scrub, elapsed and remaining, audio device) and says it replaces the background while it plays and the background returns after. The outputs state that Center and Sides show the media layer and Key never does. Prepare: a song default background and a different one per part (Chorus) picked from the same bin. Import by dragging files in or Import… (⇧⌘I), copied into the library Media folder, with empty, importing, cannot-play, drop and no-results states; All / Images / Videos filters and a name search. Three structurally different directions, each at 1440×900 and 3440×1440; every artboard has a Preview states control for Live, Full-screen video, Prepare, Dragging files in, Empty bin and No results.

artboards.title: A · Media drawer under the slides · Live
artboards.tradeoff: Chosen (owner, 2026-11-16; 03-06 are alternatives). The slide grid becomes a drawer with Slides | Images & Videos tabs (⌘1 ⌘2 shown as secondary key caps), so the bin sits where the operator already looks, with large thumbnails, visible Play Full Screen buttons and a details column; the transport docks at the top of the drawer and Prepare reuses the same drawer as the picker. Added for first-time volunteers: a plain 'On screen' line above the outputs (for example 'On screen: Lyrics · Chorus 2 of 2 · Background: Soft light loop (video, muted, looping) [Clear Background F2]') that updates with F1, F2, F3, Next and full-screen video; a click or Return always sets a muted, looping background and Play Full Screen is a separate button; a full-screen video hides the lyrics, and the lyrics and the previous background come back when it ends or on Stop Video; the empty bin says 'Drag your images and videos here, or click Import…'. Most discoverable for a volunteer and cheapest to explain; at 1440 the operator cannot see the slides and the media at the same time, and the full-screen transport and the On screen line each take height from the drawer

artboards.title: A · Media drawer under the slides · Live (ultrawide)
artboards.tradeoff: Chosen (owner, 2026-11-16; 03-06 are alternatives). At 3440 the tabs give way to a split: slides on top and the Images & Videos drawer under them (hide with ⌘M), five large thumbnails per row and a 380 px details column, with the outputs column and clear actions untouched. Added: the plain 'On screen' line at the top of the outputs column, with its Clear Background (F2) or Stop Video action; the same full-screen rule (lyrics hidden while the video plays, lyrics and previous background back when it ends or on Stop Video), click = muted looping background, and the beginner empty-bin text. Slides and media are both visible with no extra window; the slide grid loses about half its height to the drawer, so long songs scroll sooner, and the On screen line makes the outputs column a little tighter

artboards.title: B · Media section in the sidebar · Live
artboards.tradeoff: Media becomes a third sidebar section next to Service and Library (Library collapses to make room): compact rows with a small thumbnail, type, length, resolution and codec; a click shows it as the background, ⓘ or ⌘Y opens a preview popover that never goes on air, and the full-screen transport docks at the bottom of the sidebar. Keeps the Live layout of 04 exactly as it is and matches the Library pattern; the 240 px sidebar makes thumbnails tiny and truncates long names, and the popover covers part of the live panes while it is open

artboards.title: B · Media section in the sidebar · Live (ultrawide)
artboards.tradeoff: The same sidebar section at 3440 with Library expanded above it, the 08 Live layout untouched and a larger 560 px preview popover. Cheapest to build on Sidebar.swift and the most consistent across window sizes; the sidebar stays 240 px in every class, so on an ultrawide the bin uses the least space of the three and shows about eight rows

artboards.title: C · Layers panel · Live
artboards.tradeoff: The bottom bar turns into a Layers panel (Messages, Slide, Background), each row saying what is on air, which outputs show it (Center, Sides · never Key) and its own Clear key; Change… (⌘B) opens the bin as a drawer from the right over the slide grid, and full-screen video expands inside the Background row with its transport. Teaches the ADR 0008 layer model directly and makes Key never showing media impossible to miss; it adds a concept volunteers must learn, the outputs shrink to a 2×2 strip, and the drawer hides half of the slide grid while open

artboards.title: C · Layers panel · Live (ultrawide)
artboards.tradeoff: The outputs column holds the Layers panel and a 'Where each layer shows' table (Background on Key: Never); the bin is a 1180 px drawer over the slide grid with a details column, and the full-screen transport lives in the Background layer card. The clearest picture of what each screen gets, ready for per-output looks in Phase 2; the four monitors become a 2×2 grid instead of the stacked large previews the system asks for, and the bin is hidden until Change… opens it
